name: ChordRes retaining turns at attention VE sites
tagline: Carry perpendicular tangent displacement without damping at VE attention sites.
description: The original Chord position update and saved-force path are retained. At attention sites with token value tables, project the previous velocity and the current displacement onto the new tangent plane. Keep the full perpendicular displacement and average the parallel part with the carried velocity.
mechanism: Unit-RMS hidden state and a per-token tangent velocity
Independent scalar controls for each attention and FFN site
BF16 force tensors retained on the GPU for the fused Chord backward
The VE-attention write retains perpendicular displacement at unit gain.
limitations: Research comparison using matched random output initialization and elevated scalar control learning rate.
